notes.title: Update: Demo Version 1.3
notes.notes: [p]It's been a week since the Demo's initial release, and the Creatures have learned some new tricks![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/3b9ac23e720f52bb3e22b3f431f5a98c7516ecea.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/35e26957f6bb74bbef77e7b89b0a583b22d6bdaa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update brings some new features, including:[/p][list][*][p]The Void: The Deity no longer throws you back to the Title Screen after death. Get a small glimpse of their immaterial home in the Demo, and some words of encouragement.[/p][/*][*][p]Aura bonuses: extra Aura is now awarded after finishing a Block, depending on your performance.[/p][/*][*][p]More Creature behaviours: Creatures have gotten a bit smarter, friendlier, and (possibly) angrier when hungry. Try barking at your friends with C key/A button![/p][/*][*][p]Removed friendly fire from allied NPC Creatures.[/p][/*][*][p]Various other bug fixes & improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, please keep submitting bug reports and feedback, and if you played the Demo, consider leaving a review![/p][p][/p][p]Until next,[/p][p]Bianca[/p]

notes.title: Nextfest June 2025 - Release the Creatures!
notes.notes: [p]It's a big day for this quirky roguelike, and you're all invited![/p][p][/p][p]First off, I wanted to give my thanks to everyone who downloaded, wishlisted, shared or added Triumvora to their library, and to those that will! I hope Nextfest is as exciting for you as well![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/70ac78f64c3d8c318fd3abddea309de24cde3129.png"][/img][/p][p]You can finally acquaint yourself with the Creatures (which I sometimes affectionately call "Creachures"). Most of them will be gathering food, just like you, though some might end up fighting over it. You can get caught in the crossfire, or maybe you're the one that caused it? All that matters is that you make it out of Sector Zero as a Ruler.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/0ddf0a75a65e91a2b2d1544b4b00719fc338a903.png"][/img][/p][p]This day also marks a big milestone for me as a developer. The game has come a long way from its prototype days, nearly a year ago. I thought I'd share some concept art![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/b3d8b4471f04eb46de29ceda7ab8af8475fa08af.png"][/img][/p][p]Sector Zero is symbolic for me, as it's intentionally a "blank-slate" slice of Triumvora's world. The three other Sectors in the full game will have their own atmosphere, their own problems that your Creature will have to overcome, and their own Ruler to keep you on your toes.[/p][p][/p][p]What's your resource-management strategy? What Crown are you working towards? Have you reordered your attacks for different Passive Effects? I would love to hear how you're playing the Demo, I have yet to see two people play it the same way! (You will have my personal congratulations if you have finished the Demo with all three Crown types ːsteamhappyː)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537234/0d198771c32f3da3a002c94a27c788458271ecdd.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Please keep the feedback coming, it will only make the demo and full game better! If you've already played it, consider leaving a review![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Bianca[/p]
